lastResponse.text: I hear you. Thank you for calling for your neighbor. First, safety check: is she in immediate danger right now? If yes, call nine one one now. I’ll repeat: call nine one one now. If not immediate, I can give a local contact: MY NEIGHBOR, at 5-0-3, 2-8-1, 1-8-0-1. I’ll repeat: 5-0-3, 2-8-1, 1-8-0-1.
